evidence.locator:
kDEF doesn't give up when `GetResource('wnd#', d3)` returns NULL — it walks a
12-step degraded-id cascade, ANDing `d3` against a fixed mask sequence and
re-attempting until a handle resolves.
evidence.claim: GetResource(wnd#, id & mask) over twelve masks; the first non-null handle ends the cascade.
evidence.limits: Masks and landing order only. A miss reaches the no-recipe path; the runtime heuristic substitute there, base-chain ownership and Resource Manager search order are not established.

evidence.locator:
Walking gives cells **`[border[i-1], border[i])` tagged `part[i]`**
(END-based — the part code travels with the border that CLOSES the cell;
`0x5356`, confirmed in `compositor-spec.md`). Segment loop starts at index 1, so
`[0, border[0])` is the fixed leading **corner** (drawn 1:1)
evidence.claim: Segment i spans [border[i-1], border[i]) tagged part[i]; [0, border[0]) is a 1:1 corner.
evidence.limits: Cell association only; trailing-region drawing and side draw order are not established.

evidence.locator:
| 12 | **TILE** — `dstW = floor(slack/numStretch / srcW) * srcW` (whole tiles) | `0x5266`-`0x5292` |
| 8, 11, 18 | **STRETCH (grow)** — `share = sVar5/sVar6 + slack/numStretch` | `0x529e`-`0x52d6` |
| 13, 14 | **STRETCH** smaller share (`sVar5/sVar6`, no slack term) | `0x52da`-`0x52f8` |
| else | call `0x49d6(pc, fp@(24))` (the too-short byte): nonzero → leave width 0 (budget participant); else FIXED `dstW=srcW`; **except** pc∈{5,6} AND `fp@(26)`==0 → width 0 (collapse) | `0x52fc`-`0x532a` |

So **codes 5/6** (title bezel) are FIXED when the `fp@(26)` byte is nonzero
(on the title path the GetWTitle length byte `fp@(-290)`, pushed at
`0x5100`/`0x5120`; zeroed at `0x4e20` when too short and `0x4f5e` when ≤2px of
title room is left) and **collapse to 0** when it is zero —
they never grow. Budget = `slack = (srcBorder[end]−srcBorder[start-1]) − reqWidth`
(`0x518a`); the primary divisor counts only 8/11/12/18 (`0x4b3e`), while 8/11/13/14/18
share the division and whole-tile remainder. Each remainder share is truncated
against the number of recipients still to visit, so extra pixels accumulate at
the END of the walk (3/3/4 for a budget of 10 and three ordinary growers)
evidence.claim: Two-pass per-half allocation: primary 8/11/12/18, whole-tile truncation, remainder to 8/11/13/14/18 toward the end; 0x49d6 stretch verdicts leave width 0.
evidence.limits: Within one half of a given extent with a nonnegative budget. Title-anchor half extents, codes 5/6 (fp@(26) title length byte, 0x530c), widget flag values and the second too-short step (0x4e24..0x4e42) are not established. 0x49d6 receives fp@(24), the too-short byte (kdef.too-short-step).

evidence.locator: | TILE | `0x0feae` | `feae(cicn, srcRect*, dstRect*, dirByte, pixmap)` (`fp@8/12/16/20/22`) | tile along the side's run axis, one src-sized CopyBits/CopyMask per step. `dir` = anchor end, NOT axis: 1 = forward from dst top-left, 0 = reverse from dst bottom-right (`(pc==11\|\|pc==14)?0:1`). See §5.1. **Always tiles; never scales.** |
evidence.claim: Non-18 cells tile the source cell along the side, clipping the final tile. Codes 11/14 (direction byte 0) anchor at the dst end and keep the trailing source pixels in the near-end partial tile; all others anchor at the dst start.
evidence.limits: Opaque CopyBits (grafProcs non-nil) vs CopyMask, CopyMask interaction with earlier sides, the 1px LineTo fast-path colour, device colour and code-18 scaling are not established. The second consumer of the byte (0x6390 -> 0x11452) is not traced.

evidence.locator: - State bytes (0x66e8–0x6770): blob byte8 is set when ControlRecord hilite is 254 or 255, so disabled and inactive are one state; byte9 is set for any other nonzero hilite; varCode&7 in {1,3} clears byte10 and byte11, and in {2,4} clears byte10 and sets byte11 (radio).
evidence.claim: Hilite 254/255 set blob byte8 (disabled and inactive are one state); other nonzero hilite sets byte9 (pressed); varCode&7 1/3 is checkbox, 2/4 radio (byte11).
evidence.limits: Byte derivation only. Which public or caller action produces each hilite/varCode is not established.

evidence.locator: - CICN lane (0x71ec–0x728a): value is ControlRecord+18; tier starts 1, byte9 makes it 2, byte8 makes it 0; for value 2 or 3 the id -9504+12*kind+3*value+tier is fetched through 0x10472 and a NULL result sets value to 1; the id is then recomputed and fetched again at the same kind and tier. There is no retry at another tier.
evidence.claim: CICN id -9504+12*kind+3*value+tier (tier 1 normal, 2 pressed, 0 disabled); value 2/3 NULL retries value 1 at the same kind and tier; no cross-tier retry.
evidence.limits: 0x10472 is taken as GetCIcon on the current resource file chain; its 18-slot cache does not cover -9504..-9481. Provider identity is not established.

evidence.locator: - Lane order (0x728c–0x7318): a non-NULL CICN is drawn and the routine exits at 0x7310; a NULL CICN branches to the icon lane at 0x7314, which re-reads value from ControlRecord+18, so the CICN value-1 retry does not carry over.
evidence.claim: A drawn CICN ends the routine; a NULL CICN enters the icon lane, which re-reads the control value.
evidence.limits: Branch order only.

evidence.locator:
`0x731c–0x732c` starts tier 0, selects tier 1 for blob byte 9, then tier 2
for blob byte 8. `0x73b6–0x73ce` and `0x73da–0x73f2` index
`kind*24 + tier*8 + value*2`. For value 2/3, `0x73ae–0x73d8` probes the
selected `ics#` with GetResource; NULL changes only the value to 1.
evidence.claim: Icon lane tiers 0 normal/1 pressed/2 disabled index the pinned 0x18b88 table; a NULL value-2/3 ics# retries value 1.
evidence.limits: Table and probe only. The 0xf4ba draw helper (depth choice, mask requirement 0xf50c–0xf51e) and the owning file are separate.

evidence.locator: - Value 3 (0x720a–0x7232, 0x7380–0x73a2): when value is 1 and the Gestalt('Acid') response byte +20 is nonzero, value becomes 3; the CICN lane also requires byte11 = 0 (checkbox), the icon lane does not. What sets that byte is not decoded.
evidence.claim: Value 1 becomes 3 when the Gestalt(Acid) response byte +20 is set (CICN lane checkbox only).
evidence.limits: What sets the Gestalt byte is not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Resource files (0x10472–0x106ac, 0x7364–0x736c): when Gestalt('Copl') returns noErr (0x104a8), 0x10472 calls UseResFile with the low word of its response, otherwise the current file stays; ids outside its 18-slot cache, or any id when the cache base a4@(3436) is NULL (0x104b0), reach _GetCIcon (0xaa1e), which searches from that file down the resource chain; the icon lane calls UseResFile(0), the System file, before GetResource('ics#'). Which open file owns a found resource is not established for either lane.
evidence.claim: The CICN lane fetches after UseResFile(Gestalt Copl low word); the icon lane fetches after UseResFile(0).
evidence.limits: Which open file owns a found resource is not established for either lane; the archive-fork-only chain is a declared assumption.

evidence.locator: - Placement (0x72a0–0x72d2, 0x732e–0x7360, 0x7060–0x70a4): the CICN lane computes h = left + 8 - trunc(width/2) and v = trunc((top + bottom - height)/2) from the control Rect and the CIcon bounds before calling 0xf68c and 0x102d0; the icon lane offsets the global a4@(430) rect by (left + 2, (top + bottom - 12) >> 1), widens it by 2 on each side, erases it (0xa8a3) and adds 4 to its bottom; the shared label routine 0x6d22 moves the pen to left + 18 when byte10 is 0. The helper destination semantics, the a4@(430) rect and the label baseline are not decoded.
evidence.claim: CICN h = left+8-trunc(w/2), v = trunc((top+bottom-h)/2); icon rect a4@(430) offset by (left+2, (top+bottom-12)>>1); label pen h = left+18 for checkables.
evidence.limits: Arithmetic only. 0xf68c/0x102d0 destination semantics, the a4@(430) rect and the label baseline are not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Scroll state bytes (0x9f7a–0x9fd6, 0xada2, 0xa01c–0xa030): blob byte47 (inactive) is set for hilite 254, and for hilite 255 when Gestalt('appr') succeeds and GetSuperControl's parent is not active; byte20 (disabled) is set for hilite >= 254 or min == max (0xada2; read through the local helpers 0x996c/0x995a when Gestalt('apvr') is at least 0x110, else directly); a hilite of 1..253 is pressed.
evidence.claim: Hilite 254 (or 255 under an inactive Appearance parent) sets byte47 inactive; hilite >= 254 or min == max sets byte20 disabled; hilite 1..253 is pressed.
evidence.limits: Byte derivation only. Which caller action produces each hilite, and GetSuperControl/IsControlActive results, are not established.

evidence.locator: - Scroll track (0xa032–0xa10e, 0xbcc6): byte21 (0xadfe: width > height) selects base -8288, else -8280; tier is 0 when byte47, else 1 when byte20, else 3 when pressed, else 2; the track cicn is base + tier fetched with _GetCIcon after UseResFile(Gestalt 'Copl' low word, 0x9f3e–0x9f58); when the thickness (0xbc92) is at most 11 the id + 18 is probed first; when Acid byte +33 (byte18) is set and the along length is at least 8 × thickness the id + 4 is probed first; a NULL result is not retried at another tier.
evidence.claim: Track cicn = (-8288 horizontal | -8280 vertical) + tier (0 inactive, 1 disabled, 2 normal, 3 pressed); small (+18) and +4 variants probed first when their gates are set; no cross-tier retry.
evidence.limits: Fetched with _GetCIcon after UseResFile(Gestalt Copl); which open file supplies a found id is not established. The +4 gate bytes come from the undecoded Gestalt(Acid) block.

evidence.locator: - Scroll composite flag (0xa14e–0xa184): byte72 is set when the selected track cicn's bounds exceed 16 in width or height.
evidence.claim: byte72 = the selected track cicn bounds exceed 16 in width or height; it selects arrow boxes cut from the track (set) or arrow icons (clear).
evidence.limits: Flag only; the arrow box extents and track fill are not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Scroll track pattern (0xa112–0xa14a): a ppat with the record id a2@(66) is fetched (on a miss: id - 4 when the +4 track variant was taken, then base + tier); 0xba0e and 0xc6e4 draw with it when present, by a path not decoded here.
evidence.claim: A ppat with the track record id is fetched and used by the track and arrow draws when present.
evidence.limits: The ppat draw path is not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Scroll arrows (0x9f0e–0x9f38, 0xc338–0xc84a): an inactive control (byte47) draws no arrow (0xc34a); with byte72 the arrow boxes come from the track cicn, and for a pressed control each arrow that is not the hit one uses cicn a2@(66) - 1 (0xc3cc–0xc3fe); without byte72 the icon id is the blob word at +24 + 8*high + 4*vertical + 2*hit (0xc79e–0xc7b6), hit meaning hilite 20 for the low arrow and 21 for the high one, and a disabled control (byte20) instead uses -10206/-10205 horizontal or -10208/-10207 vertical (0xc7ba–0xc7fa); icons are drawn through 0xf4ba, which requires the ics# (0xf50c–0xf51e) and draws the ics8 from the ics#'s own file, or the 1-bit ics# image when there is none; ics4 is never requested.
evidence.claim: Inactive: no arrows. Composite track: arrow boxes from the track cicn, non-hit boxes of a pressed control from id - 1. Otherwise icon ids from the record table (hit = hilite 20 low / 21 high), disabled ids -10206/-10205 (h) or -10208/-10207 (v); 0xf4ba requires the ics# mask.
evidence.limits: Selection only. Icon depth, the resource file in force at 0xf4ba and box geometry are not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Scroll thumb (0xaed6–0xaf84): nothing is drawn if 0xbbf4 yields an empty track rect; a disabled control (byte20) fills the whole track rect (0xaf08–0xaf20) and draws no thumb; hilite 129 selects -10205 horizontal or -10207 vertical, otherwise -10206 or -10208; at thickness 11 or less the id + 1956 is probed first; both go through 0x10472.
evidence.claim: Disabled (byte20): no thumb. Otherwise -10205/-10207 for hilite 129, else -10206/-10208 (horizontal/vertical), small +1956 first, through 0x10472.
evidence.limits: Drawn only when the track rect (0xbbf4) and the thumb rect (length 0xab68, position 0xa97c) are non-empty; that geometry is decoded in docs/spec/engine/scrollbar.md (non-empty at the sampled length 120) but this row asserts selection only.

evidence.locator: - Scroll draw order (0xa44c–0xa4e2): arrow 0 (low) always, arrow 2 when byte18, arrow 3 (high) always, arrow 1 when byte18, then the thumb, then the track.
evidence.claim: The draw message draws arrow 0 and arrow 3 (and arrows 2/1 under the Acid double-arrow byte), then the thumb, then the track.
evidence.limits: Order only; 0xf2d6 is not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Selection (0xc1e8–0xc1f8): zero raw state selects -9568, any nonzero state -9567.
evidence.claim: Zero raw UInt32 state selects -9568, any nonzero state -9567.
evidence.limits: Callback dispatch only; resource file ownership is not established.

evidence.locator: - Regions (0x72a8–0x762a): corners c×c are clamped to the source bounds. The top/bottom bands are s rows over destination x [c, W−c), the left/right bands s columns over [c, H−c). When cinf[2] is zero the band source is one column/row (0x7396–0x73a4, 0x756c–0x757a).
evidence.claim: Clamped c x c corners and independent s-thick bands in TL, TR, top, BL, BR, bottom, left, right order; one source column/row when cinf[2] is zero.
evidence.limits: Sampled-line colours stand in as raster colours only under an equivalent sampling record.

evidence.locator: - Body (0x71a2–0x7202): inset (c horizontal, s vertical), then the transposed inset when c≠s, both sharing P. The pattern is used iff the archive ships the cinf+4 ppat; otherwise the body is solid from the raw sample.
evidence.claim: Inset and transposed inset bodies share P; the cinf+4 ppat when present, else the raw background sample.
evidence.limits: Archive-fork-only ppat lookup is a declared assumption.

evidence.locator: - Pattern anchor (0x7156–0x719e): P is the paint Rect's TL/TR/BL/BR for modes 1–4, else the absolute point (0,0), so mode 0 and mode 1 differ only away from origin (0,0).

evidence.limits: The original pattern offset R is not established.

evidence.locator: - Fallback colours (0x1ba–0x376): helper 0x263a is GetResource('clut'). States 0–4 of both fallback ladders (-9968..-9964, -9960..-9956; -9963..-9961 and -9955 are not recoloured) get icon colour-table entries from clut -14336 (ids -9964/-9967/-9956/-9959) or clut -14335 (-9965/-9968/-9957/-9960). The pressed ids -9966/-9958 also sample two colours from cicn -10238 at cinf -10238 (or cinf 0) points through 0x1bce. Before GetCIcon, 0x16e makes the Gestalt('Copl') file current (0x198–0x1b8). assessments.rationale: Unknown: promotion rejected at review (see review). kdef231-reference.md §5.1 decodes the 0xfeae direction byte (pc==11||pc==14)?0:1 as the tile anchor, not the axis: 11/14 tile from the dst end (0x1018a) and every other code from the start (0x10088). The axis comes from srcH==dstH (0x10146/0x10236), with the cross axis fixed by 0x5356. The window.recipe-rules assertion checks source offset k%sw forward and sw-1-((dw-1-k)%sw) reverse for every non-18 cell, unknown-class cells included, at their runtime-placed widths. The Node test records per-archive mutation discrimination: the flip-11/14 (pre-fix) runtime fails animals and monkey-paradise; inverted-anchor and scaled runtimes fail 1990, animals, crayon-os, dolphin-som, evolution, floppies and monkey-paradise; the other six archives pass every mutation. The runtime drawTile anchors 11/14 at the far end. Limits: opaque source pixels only; opaque CopyBits under grafProcs and the CopyMask order over earlier sides are not modelled; runtime cross-axis placement and side-bar window; sampled sizes; no native capture.

assessments.rationale: Verified narrowly for this case: every non-18 wnd# recipe cell agrees with the decoded 0xfeae tiling (kdef231-reference.md §5.1): along-run source offset k % sw for direction byte 1 and sw-1-((dw-1-k) % sw) for byte 0 (codes 11/14), cross axis 1:1, opaque source pixels, at template + {0,1,2,7,97} x {0,1,33}. The check fails for this archive under inverted-anchor and scaled blits. No 11/14 cell has a >1px non-uniform source, so the 11/14 reverse anchor is direction-neutral here and not discriminated; only the byte-1 forward anchor and tiling-vs-scaling are. Limits: agreement with the decode, not original-engine pixels; no native capture. Opaque source pixels only; opaque CopyBits under grafProcs (port+92) and the CopyMask order over earlier sides are not modelled. assessments.rationale: Verified narrowly for this case: every non-18 wnd# recipe cell agrees with the decoded 0xfeae tiling (kdef231-reference.md §5.1): along-run source offset k % sw for direction byte 1 and sw-1-((dw-1-k) % sw) for byte 0 (codes 11/14), cross axis 1:1, opaque source pixels, at template + {0,1,2,7,97} x {0,1,33}. The check fails for this archive under inverted-anchor and scaled blits. It also fails under forward-tiled 11/14 (the pre-fix runtime), so the 11/14 reverse anchor is discriminated. Limits: agreement with the decode, not original-engine pixels; no native capture. Opaque source pixels only; opaque CopyBits under grafProcs (port+92) and the CopyMask order over earlier sides are not modelled. Cross-axis origin and placed widths come from the runtime; 0x5178 widths are a separate requirement; unknown-class cell widths are not source-determined, so their tiling is checked over the runtime-placed width only. Side bars are checked only between the top and bottom bars; overlap regions and trailing vertical regions are excluded. Sampled sizes only. The 1px LineTo fast path (0xff3e/0xffba) colour equivalence and the second byte consumer 0x6390 -> 0x11452 are not established.
